The Blocks of One Distribution Parameter

Source: R/inference.R
summary_blocks.Rd

Groups a parameter's terms into the readings a summary prints: the parametric terms together, and one block per penalized term.

Usage

summary_blocks(fit, spec, design, p, ci)

Arguments

fit

A StatmodFit.

spec

The specification.

design

The design.

p

The distribution parameter.

ci

The flat interval table, as confint.StatmodFit returns it with the statistic and the p-value added.

Value

A list of block records, each with kind, label, n_coef, edf, n_zero and table.
